snippet.title: THE CUP - Official Trailer | a free card battler where everyone watches the die
snippet.description:
A free 1v1 creature card battler where there is no skip button - you field a team, play cards, and everyone watches the die. Play now, in your browser.

▶ PLAY FREE — https://cupqualifier.app/?src=yt-desc#code=PLAYBALL  (PC or phone · nothing to install)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
INCOMING TRANSMISSION — GALACTIC ATHLETICS COMMISSION

A hundred years after the end of the world, an alien athletics commission found Earth's feral wildlife and its stubborn survivors, declared the whole planet an Invitational, and started broadcasting. You're at the qualifier.

THE CUP is a free-to-play 1v1 creature card battler that runs in your browser. Field a survivor and a line of three creatures, then play cards, roll dice, and hold the center of the pit. No account wall, no download — just a link.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
▸ 59 contestants, all real animals. Every creature is a mutated North American animal entered under its true natural history — and the real fact is printed on every card. The pronghorn really has been outrunning a ghost for 12,000 years.
▸ Variance is a choice. Every creature is tagged SAFE, SWINGY, or JACKPOT. The gamble is always one you opted into - and everyone watches the die land.
▸ No skip button. The animation IS the payoff; the spectacle carries the information.
▸ Four formats. Instant AUTO teams, SURVIVOR pick, HALF-DRAFT, and FULL-DRAFT.
▸ Always someone to fight. Live 1v1 by invite link, single-elimination Gauntlets with medals, or THE HOUSE - the always-on sparring bot with seven nameplates and one grudge.

HOW TO PLAY (60 seconds to learn)
Pick your team → play a card or attack → when a creature swings, its variance decides how hard. SAFE creatures do what they say. JACKPOT creatures roll for it. Hold the center, drop their line, take the pit.

EARLY ACCESS, HONESTLY
This is a live playtest. Cards get rebalanced weekly, things occasionally break, and bug reports land on the dev desk the same day. Early testers keep the EARTH'S BEST TESTER badge permanently.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

▶ PLAY FREE — https://cupqualifier.app/?src=yt-desc#code=PLAYBALL
💬 THE GREEN ROOM (Discord) — https://discord.gg/SPVGfs6Ta
🛰 THE STANDS (Reddit) — https://www.reddit.com/r/CupQualifier/

New die-roll shorts weekly. Subscribe to catch the qualifier as it airs.

A broadcast of the Galactic Athletics Commission. LIVE* - as of approximately 42 light-years ago. The feed is recorded.
